title: Prodigy spotted at age 12 or 13 and recruited by the MIT president

tellings.quote: example Harold Mgrren, he was spotted when he was like 12 or 13 years old.

plain: A man named Harold Malmgren was spotted as a gifted child at about 12 or 13 and recruited by the president of MIT, with Rensselaer and Yale also part of his path. The researcher Matthew Pines tells Michels this without naming a source and sets it beside the mathematician James Simons. He offers it as an example of how the system finds talented young people early and steers them.
